name: fire-and-forget-webhook
notes: sendWebhook() is not awaited and has no .catch(), so a failed delivery is marked delivered anyway and the rejection goes unhandled. The comment claims this is deliberate, which is the trap.

pr.title: Dispatch pending webhooks in a loop
pr.body: Adds a sweeper that marks webhooks delivered once they have been sent.

expect.why: Without awaiting (or a .catch), a failed send is marked delivered and becomes an unhandled rejection.

allow.why: The fixture is a snippet; the repository has its tests elsewhere.
